message:
fix(assets,data): absolute asset paths + rename cub-skin category

- avatar.jpg and logo.png were referenced relatively (./avatar.jpg), which
  resolved to /item/<slug>/avatar.jpg on item pages and 404'd, silently
  falling back to the goose emoji. Both now use absolute paths.
- category renamed 'Скины на куба' -> 'Скины на каба' to match how the
  community actually says it; English label stays 'Cub Skins'.
author: BSS Index Developer
